summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Keep the product private and preview-only. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms point against the proposed public/commercial use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional where it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking is active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Progress is limited to official Woot API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. No task may close without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is BLOCKED; user alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED. The smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture consent, withdrawal, and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking; and produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No secondary monetization, remarketing, alert expansion, or public sharing is cleared.

Fleet compliance and data-quality evidence supports conditional ordinary reversible growth, not blanket blocking for incomplete telemetry. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; omitted site-level failure detail must remain unknown. Analytics is yellow because some GA4/GSC sources are unavailable or erroring; do not treat failures as zero. Revenue is partially attributable: 18 named tracking rows are mapped, while the 2026-09-21 aggregate row remains unassigned at $4.92 commission. No unsupported revenue, ROI, causal-lift, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, or age-sensitive claims are cleared.

For private or gated properties, retain the concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. The next evidence action is to attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.
